groups.title: State and the absolutive NNC formula
groups.proposal: Build an absolutive NNC as a subject plus nounstem predicate with vacant State and no tense position.
groups.writingJob: Preserve the typed NNC subject, predicate, State, and formula boundaries.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader in distinguishing State from Valence and an NNC from a VNC.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses State; the application builds the corresponding NNC structure.

groups.title: Subject and number connectors
groups.proposal: Select every person and number carrier from subject, State, noun class, and boundary conditions.
groups.writingJob: Select and realize the authorized subject and number dyads, supportive vowels, and assimilation automatically.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader in keeping State-conditioned number connectors inside the subject rather than the predicate.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses subject person and number; the application selects connector morphs.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Subject; do not expose connector morphs as choices.

groups.title: Complete absolutive subject paradigm
groups.proposal: Generate the complete absolutive subject inventory without asking the user to choose its automatic morphs.
groups.writingJob: Generate every valid person, number, and noun-class subject shape through the same canonical NNC owner.
groups.readingJob: Guide recognition of singular, common, and plural subject shapes and their English correspondences.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses subject coordinates; the application produces the exact shape and full paradigm.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Subject and Full paradigm; no connector picker.

groups.title: Nounstem predicate and translation
groups.proposal: Keep the nounstem predicative and tenseless while allowing context-sensitive translation.
groups.writingJob: Build the nounstem as an identifying, describing, or locating predicate without inventing tense or definiteness.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader from the Nahuatl predicate to a context-appropriate English sentence.
groups.decisionSplit: The application preserves Nahuatl structure; the reader supplies contextual English time and definiteness.
groups.controlPolicy: No new control until a genuine sentence context supplies the choice.

groups.title: Animacy, reference, and number
groups.proposal: Use typed animacy and actual subject reference to allow singular, common, plural, and metaphorical constructions.
groups.writingJob: Enforce animacy-number applicability while allowing a deliberate metaphorical animate reading.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader in separating subject number from nounstem inflection and resolving reference from context.
groups.decisionSplit: The user supplies intended reference only when it changes the grammatical reading; the application enforces compatibility.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Animacy and Metaphorical use; no noun-plural control.

groups.title: State selection and lexical restrictions
groups.proposal: Allow ordinary nounstems in either State and enforce only genuine lexical State restrictions.
groups.writingJob: Admit both States by default and block a State only when typed lexical authority requires it.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader in distinguishing State choice from a verbstem's control of Valence.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses State where grammar permits it; the application enforces lexical restrictions.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse State; unavailable choices are disabled automatically.
